options.title: The prototype
options.line: Every state of today drawn on the chosen structure, free rooms first, with the blocking findings fixed and read again.

seats.line: Of the four blocking findings, three are fixed and one is fixed in part: every Book button now has a name, but focus in the booking dialog still starts on Cancel.
Asked to put a walk-in into a free room, the reader did it in two clicks from the screen, at both widths.

findings.line: Fixed in part: focus in the booking dialog starts on Cancel, not on the patient's name.
Still present: the empty state offers a waiting list, which the product does not have.

recommendation.reason: Approve it for Look and carry the two open findings there as named fixes, since neither changes the structure.

question: Do you approve the prototype of today for Look?
